source_note: Topic structure follows the AQA GCSE Spanish specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

units.name: Communication and the world around us
units.blurb: Travel and tourism, including places of interest

topics.name: Travel and tourism, including places of interest
The environment and where people live

connections.why: Talking about yourself and others extends naturally into describing health, diet and daily routine
Describing people and relationships supplies the vocabulary for discussing public figures and role models
Sport, diet and wellbeing overlap heavily with how people spend their leisure time
School trips, exchanges and future careers abroad connect study and work with travel
Leisure pursuits include the festivals and celebrations a culture enjoys together
Much modern free time is spent on streaming, gaming and social media
Festivals and popular celebrities both express the cultural identity of a country
Celebrity culture is created and amplified through media and technology
Tourism and the places people visit raise questions about the local environment
Technology and how/where people live both shape environmental impact
Listening and reading are the two receptive skills, both tested on the same themes
Speaking and writing are the two productive skills that reuse the same topic vocabulary
The role-play and conversation in the speaking exam draw directly on the personal-identity theme
Environmental issues are common prompts for the extended writing and translation tasks
Travel and directions are staple contexts for listening comprehension tasks
Texts about school and careers are frequent reading-comprehension sources
